notes.title: Celebrating Our Hockey Queens
notes.content:
[h1]Celebrating Our Hockey Queens: A Special Update Just For You Ladies!
[/h1]
We've got some sparkling news that’s going to make your VR experience even more immersive and exciting. This update’s all about celebrating the incredible women in hockey and those who game with passion and flair. 🏒👑

[previewyoutube=K9WggJBxZK8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Why a Gender-Specific Update?
[/h2]Over the years, we've noticed the growing number of female players enjoying our Hockey Shooter VR game. We believe in creating a space where everyone feels represented, and our female players deserve the recognition and representation they've been asking for. This update isn’t about dividing the game by gender, but rather enhancing the experience for a group of players we’ve seen grow and flourish. 

[h2]Here’s What’s New!
[/h2][b]1. Gender Selection:[/b] Our avatars have always been one-size-fits-all, but we recognize that our diverse community of players deserves more choice. Now, when you gear up for a game, you can select your gender and play as a female hockey superstar. Celebrate every slap shot, goal, and victory with a new level of authenticity.

[b]2. Exclusive Accessories:[/b] To make things even more sensational, we're rolling out an all-new set of accessories!Whether you want to dazzle the competition with your skills or your fashion sense, we've got you covered. 

We’re thrilled about this update and the opportunity it brings to celebrate the amazing women in our community. The passion, commitment, and skill you bring every time you step onto that virtual rink inspire us, and we wanted to make sure our game reflects just how sensational you truly are.

To all our Hockey Shooter VR players, regardless of gender, we thank you for your continued support and dedication to the game. Every update, every tweak, every improvement is all for you.

Slide into our virtual store now and check out the new accessories set. Game on, and shine on, hockey queens! 🌟🏒👑

Warm regards,

The Hockey Shooter VR Team

notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
[h1]Get ready for the ultimate immersive hockey experience with the new era of Hockey Shooter VR game! [/h1]

[h2]The latest update brings a range of exciting features that will take your gaming experience to the next level.[/h2]

The game now includes a whole [b]new Locker room[/b] area, which serves as a central hub for users to access different game modes and features. Additionally, a new [b]Goalie game mode[/b] has been added to the game, providing an opportunity to test your skills in the goalkeeping position.

The [b]UI has been revamped and updated[/b] to provide a more user-friendly interface. Moreover, a new Environment has been introduced, offering a fresh and [b]exciting playing experience[/b]. 
You'll also notice a significant change in the scoring system, with [b]huge LED screens[/b] replacing the old floating scoreboards.

[b]One of the most exciting updates is the option to Calibrate the scale of the player visual and your hockey stick to your actual height,[/b] providing an even more personalized experience. And to top it all off, that now available a customization option for the player's jersey, helmet, gloves and even accessories like hockey sticks and pucks.

Players can now [b]gather in-game currency[/b] (Coins) with [b]repeatable challenges[/b] and they can use these coins to buy customization items.

[previewyoutube=q5IhODf_BAU;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't miss out on the action. Download the latest update now and experience the new era of Hockey Shooter VR game!

Try the game and [b]help us with your feedback[/b] to make the game even better for you!

[url=https://discord.gg/n444dRehQ5]Hockey Shooter VR Discord server[/url]
